outcome: Rate of applications for a second child
cohort: Women in Jiangbei District of Ningbo City, China who gave birth to a second child between January 17, 2014 and January 14, 2016
finding: The introduction of the two-child policy in China led to an increase in applications for second births and a higher proportion of older mothers (≥35 years), which was associated with higher rates of cesarean deliveries and gestational diabetes mellitus.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were higher among women aged ≥35 years.
